prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1134; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked across the center with the lower valance torn free, and the left tail lamp assembly broken at its mounting points. The trunk lid shows a crease running into the panel edge, and the rear quarter panel has a shallow dent consistent with the reported rear-end impact. Structural rails appear straight and undamaged. The repair plan covers replacement of the bumper cover and valance, a new tail lamp, refinishing of the trunk lid, and paintless or conventional repair of the quarter panel as the metal allows. Labor hours are in line with the damage shown. No prior damage to this vehicle is known to us, and the invoices submitted show no repeated charges.
